qwen_0_5b.pros: Extremely fast token generation (~42 tok/s, ~2-4s per response) and low memory footprint (~400MB).
qwen_0_5b.cons: Severely prone to negation and holding inversion (e.g., claiming vulgarity equates to obscenity). Cannot be trusted for unverified legal generation.
qwen_0_5b.mitigation: Policy 3 and fail-closed citation verification catch inversions as rejected_answer, preventing false verification.

phi_3_5.pros: Sound legal reasoning; correctly preserves negations and nuances on statutory and constitutional questions.
phi_3_5.cons: Prohibitively slow on CPU (14s-26s warm, timeouts on multi-passage unbudgeted prompts), high memory footprint (~2.2GB).
phi_3_5.mitigation: Budget B2 reduces prompt tokens by 70%, preventing context-length timeouts.
